memories.content: The administration is considering a new patient visitation policy. They have the authority to implement policy changes. They are aware of the October 1 deadline but have not yet decided on the policy details or implementation timeline.

St. Mary's Hospital currently has an existing patient visitation policy. A proposal for a new policy has been drafted and is under review. The hospital operates under standard administrative procedures for policy changes, which may involve approvals and communication to staff.
